# three.js (vendored)

three.js r186 (npm `three@0.186.1`), MIT licence (see LICENSE). Copied unchanged from the npm
package: `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`, `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`,
`examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js`.
For the 3D view (milestone 8). OrbitControls imports the bare specifier `three`; the bundler
must alias it to `vendor/three/three.module.js`.
